entities.name: Zur
entities.description: Powerful wizard of the Dominarian Ice Age, known as Zur the Enchanter or Zur the Mad, who gained immortality.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Famous royal mage of Kjeldor and rival of Zur.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Land from which Zur was exiled.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Ancient mage who thwarted Zur and is now a professor at the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy where Jodah is a professor.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Dominarian era in which Zur was prominent.

events.summary: Zur starts a magical war in Kjeldor and is exiled for his insane attempts to achieve eternal life.
events.quote: started a magical war in that land a generation before the World Spell and was exiled

events.summary: Zur attacks his former homeland but is thwarted in part by Jodah.
events.quote: His efforts were thwarted, however, in part by the ancient mage Jodah

events.summary: Zur ventures into the tundra and disappears, secretly attaining immortality.
events.quote: he attained immortality deep in the frozen wastes

events.summary: Around 4562 AR Zur reappears before Jodah asking for a job.
events.quote: he reappeared before Jodah, asking for a job

relations.quote: Zur was a rival of the famous Gustha Ebbasdotter

relations.note: Jodah helped thwart Zur's attack and watches him now.
relations.quote: Jodah is keeping an eye on him.
